extName: Tabazing: Visual Tab Switcher with Live Previews
extDesc: Alt+Tab for Chrome tabs: live previews, instant search and recently closed tabs. Free, private, nothing leaves your computer.
cmdOpen: Open Tabazing on the previous card in the list (wraps around); let go of Alt to switch
cmdReverse: Open Tabazing on the next card in the list (wraps around); let go of Alt to switch
cmdStay: Open Tabazing and keep it open
searchPlaceholder: Search tabs, history, bookmarks and the archive
noMatch: No open tabs match your search.
noStarredOpen: No open tabs are starred. Star one with the ☆ on its card.
sleepingTip: Asleep: Chrome unloaded this tab to save memory. It reloads when you open it.
captureTitle: Shows this tab for a moment to take its picture, then comes back
pickTitle: Select. Shift+click a box to select everything from the last one you ticked.
dupesTitle: Show the pages that are open more than once (same address, ignoring the #part). You then choose to close the extra copies.
sweepAll: {count, plural, one {# without preview · Capture it} other {# without preview · Capture all}}
sweepThese: {count, plural, one {# without preview · Capture it} other {# without preview · Capture these}}
sweepFirst: {count, plural, other {# without preview · Capture first {max}}}
sweepTitleAll: Shows each of your tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.
sweepTitleThese: Shows each of these tabs for a moment to take its picture, then puts you back where you were.
sweepTitleOne: You can also capture one tab from its card.
copyFailed: This page won’t let Tabazing use the clipboard. Try from the popup (New Tab page).
sleptNone: Nothing to put to sleep (Chrome won’t unload the tab you’re on).
keyOpen: open the selected card or search result
tour3Body: Just type, typos are fine. It searches your open and closed tabs, history, bookmarks and the archive.
tourManyBody: Tick tabs with their boxes, or {key}+click the cards (Shift+click a box ticks a range). Then close, copy, move or put them to sleep together from the bar at the bottom.
askTitle: How is Tabazing working for you?
askBody: Ten seconds. It tells me what to build next. Your answer stays on your computer; the buttons only open a page where you choose what to send.
askGoodBody: A review is the best way to help other people find Tabazing.
askBadBody: Tell me what would make it work for you. A review is welcome too, whenever you like.
reviewBtn: Review on the Chrome Web Store
askNote: Each opens in a new tab. Tabazing itself sends nothing.
hostBlocked: Chrome is keeping Tabazing away from your sites, so there are no previews yet.
hostBlockedTip: Chrome’s “Site access” for Tabazing isn’t set to “On all sites”. Without it Tabazing can’t take previews or hear Alt+Q on web pages.
hostThanks: Thanks. Tabazing can see your sites now. Previews fill in as you visit tabs.
capErrHost: Chrome isn’t letting Tabazing look at this page, so it has no picture. Allowing Tabazing on all sites usually fixes that.
capErrPage: Chrome doesn’t allow pictures of this kind of page.
capErrOther: Tabazing couldn’t take a picture of this page just now.
flyoutBody: Press {key} and keep holding Alt to see your tabs; let go to switch.
flyoutSub: Or click the Tabazing icon in the toolbar.
nudgeBody: Press {key} and keep holding Alt: all your tabs, with previews. Let go of Alt to switch.
sweepNote: Each tab shows for a moment. You’ll be back where you were.
captureBlocked: Chrome doesn’t allow a preview of this page.
captureFailed: No preview this time: the page didn’t finish loading. Try again in a moment.
sleepLaterN: {count, plural, one {# tab goes to sleep when you close Tabazing} other {# tabs go to sleep when you close Tabazing}}
willSleep: Goes to sleep when you close Tabazing
sweepNothing: Nothing to capture: every tab here already has a preview, or can’t have one.
actCloseTitle: Close the selected tabs. They stay under Recently closed.
actCopyTitle: Copy their addresses, one per line
actCopyMdTitle: Copy “- [Title](link)” lines: they paste as clickable titles in Notion, Obsidian, GitHub, Slack or Docs
selAllMatches: {count, plural, one {Select the matching tab} other {Select all # matching tabs}}
selAllTabs: {count, plural, one {Select the tab} other {Select all # tabs}}
dupesSummary: {count, plural, one {# extra copy: one tab of each page stays} other {# extra copies: one tab of each page stays}}
notePh: Write a note for this tab…
noteHint: Saved as you type. Empty it to remove the note.
ageDays: {count, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
tourSwitchBody: Hold Alt and press Q to see your tabs; let go to switch. While you hold Alt, Q goes to the previous card in the list and W to the next (both wrap around), and so does the mouse wheel.
keyPrevTab: previous card in the list (wraps around)
keyNextTab: next card in the list (wraps around)
keyUndo: undo: reopen what you closed, put back what you moved
tourCardsBody: The buttons on its picture pin it, snooze it, archive it or leave yourself a note; ⋯ has the rest (copy the link, reload, mute, put to sleep…).
tourCardsMouse: Shift+click a preview to see it big, {key}+click to tick a card, right-click for its menu, middle-click to close the tab.
tourSortBody: Recently used first. Choose “By order” to see them as in the tab strip, and drag cards to move tabs. Pinned tabs come first (Settings can turn that off).
setAllWindowsNote: Off: only the window you open Tabazing in.
mergeN: {count, plural, one {Merge # window into this one} other {Merge # windows into this one}}
mergedN: {count, plural, one {Moved # tab into this window} other {Moved # tabs into this window}}
enterSearch: Press Enter to search Google for “{text}”.
noMatchShift: No open tabs match. Shift+Enter searches Google.
snoozedN: {count, plural, one {Snoozed # tab until {time}} other {Snoozed # tabs until {time}}}
snoozeCant: These pages can’t be reopened later.
keyPreview: big preview (← → for the next one)
ddNoMarks: Bookmarks can’t be searched yet: reload Tabazing at chrome://extensions to turn on its bookmarks access.
ddNoHistory: History can’t be searched yet: reload Tabazing at chrome://extensions to turn on its history access.
setStartupNote: Shows all your tabs, where you left off, a few seconds after Chrome opens.
shortcutMissing: Alt+Q isn’t set for Tabazing: another app or extension may have it. Pick a shortcut in Chrome.
iconTip: Tip: {key} opens Tabazing from anywhere, no mouse needed.
tourSetBody: Language, theme and card size, what the cards show, what search includes, opening Tabazing when Chrome starts, and this tour again.
archiveThis: Archive this tab (moves it to the “Tabs Archive” bookmarks folder)
archiveEmpty: No archived tabs yet. Archive a tab with the box button on its card.
archiveOpenTip: Open and take out of the archive: {title}
searchPhNoMarks: Search tabs, history and the archive
searchPhNoHistory: Search tabs, bookmarks and the archive
keyWheel: step through the cards while you hold Alt
keyTabHeld: next / previous card while you hold Alt
keyNumberPlain: switch to that card (when you’re not typing in the search box)
keyOpenTyped: open what you typed as an address, or search Google for it
keyRange: tick every card from the last one you ticked
keyExtend: tick a range from the selected card
keyType: search tabs, history, bookmarks and the archive
keyEsc: clears the search, then leaves Duplicates, then clears the ticks, then closes Tabazing
tourKeysMore: Every shortcut is behind the ⓘ at the top.
tourLaterBody: Snooze closes a tab and brings it back when you choose. Archive keeps it in a bookmarks folder, out of the way: this button shows them all.
tourWinBody: Your windows, each with what it shows. Pick one to see only its tabs (Ctrl+← / Ctrl+→), or merge them all into this one.
tourPlayerBody: What plays in your tabs: pause it or skip from here. The arrow lists everything playing.
movedN: {count, plural, one {Moved # tab to a new window} other {Moved # tabs to a new window}}
movedBackN: {count, plural, one {Put # tab back} other {Put # tabs back}}
errClose: Couldn’t close that tab. Try again.
errMove: Couldn’t move the tabs. Chrome may be busy; try again.
errPin: Couldn’t pin or unpin the tab. Try again in a moment.
errSleep: Couldn’t put the tab to sleep.
errArchive: Couldn’t archive the tab: Chrome didn’t let Tabazing change your bookmarks.
errUnarchive: Couldn’t take it out of the archive.
errMerge: Nothing was merged: Chrome didn’t move the tabs.
snoozePast: Pick a time that hasn’t passed yet.
setOwnWindow: Always open in its own window
setOwnWindowNote: Instead of over the page you’re on.
ntpSearch: Search Google or type an address
ntpHint: Press {key} to see all your tabs
ntpHintHold: Keep {mod} held and press {letter} again to move along; let go to switch.
ntpHintUnset: Chrome has no shortcut set for Tabazing. {key} still works on web pages and here.
cmdPalette: Open Tabazing's command palette: actions, calculations, conversions and search
palPlaceholder: Type a command, a sum like 2+2, 10 km in mi, or search
palNothing: Nothing matches. Try another word, a sum like 2+2, or 10 km in mi.

palFootBack: ↑ ↓ choose · Enter run · Shift+Enter run and stay · Esc back to your tabs
palCopyHint: Enter copies the result, Shift+Enter the whole expression
palCurrency: Currency conversion needs today’s exchange rates
palCurrencyWhy: Those come from the internet, and Tabazing never connects to it.
palCloseOthers: Close the other tabs in this window
palMoveWindow: Move this tab to a new window
palSleepOld: Put tabs not used for a week to sleep
palErrIncognito: Chrome didn’t open an Incognito window. It may be turned off on this computer.
palErrReopen: There is no closed tab to reopen.
palErrZoom: Couldn’t change the zoom of this page.

palKwExtPage: extension settings details permissions site access tabazing manage
palKwChromeShortcuts: shortcuts keyboard hotkeys keys extensions change
palKwClearData: clear browsing data cache cookies delete history privacy
palKwMute: mute unmute sound audio silence tab
palKwDupes: duplicates close copies same tabs clean
palKwSleepOld: sleep discard memory old unused tabs week
palKwTheme: theme dark light mode colours colors appearance
palKwMedia: media music video play pause next previous
keyPalette: the command palette, from any page
keyPaletteStay: in the palette: run and stay (a result: copy the whole expression)
tourPaletteBody: Type > in the search box, or press {key} anywhere: Chrome and Tabazing commands, sums, conversions (10 km in mi, 70f in c), colours, time zones and your search results, in one list.
